sn45.63:1.2: Ekadhammo bhikkhave bahupakāro ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa uppādāya || ||
sn45.63:1.5: Kalyāṇamittassetam bhikkhave bhikkhuno paṭikaṅkhaṃ ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāvessati a- a- maggam bahulīkarissati || ||
sn45.63:1.6: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto a- a- maggam bhāveti a- a- maggam bahulīkaroti || || 4.
sn45.63:1.7: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitam nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || la (pe) || sammāsamādhim bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodha nissitaṃ vossaggapariṇamiṃ || ||
sn45.63:1.8: Evam kho bhikkhave bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāveti a- amaggam bahulīkarotī ti || || 2.
